description:
About Scytale

Scytale is a global leader, an AI-powered company transforming how organizations achieve and maintain trust and compliance. Our platform automates frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX ITGC, GDPR, PCI DSS, and 60+ more frameworks, making compliance smarter, faster, and continuously audit-ready.

Built for startups, scale-ups, and enterprises, Scytale combines intelligent automation, real-time monitoring, and AI-driven insights to reduce manual work and eliminate compliance blind spots. Recognized as a G2 Leader in GRC and an AWS Rising Star Partner of the Year, Scytale is trusted by hundreds of companies worldwide and known for its technology and partnership-driven approach.


Role Overview

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our core R&D team and help build our cloud-based platform. You’ll work across the stack, shaping the architecture, implementing new features, optimizing performance, and mentoring team members to uphold high standards. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact on a platform automating IT auditing for SaaS companies globally.


Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years in Node.js and 2+ years in React, with experience building and operating production services at a meaningful scale.
  • Microservices Expertise: Proven production experience with microservices architecture.
  • Database Knowledge: Strong skills with relational and non-relational databases.
  • API Development: Experience building and integrating REST APIs.
  • AI-Augmented Development: Strong proficiency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot) and modern AI-assisted development practices as part of day-to-day work.
  • Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with AWS or similar providers.
  • Leadership: Ability to mentor and lead technical projects.
  • Communication: Proficient in English with strong verbal and written skills.
  • DevOps Awareness: Knowledge of containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) is a strong advantage.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Proficient in software design principles and patterns with a motivated, self-driven approach.


Bonus Points for:

  • Experience developing high-scale SaaS solutions.
  • Experience developing AI Features (Agents, GenAI, Lang etc.)
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD and QA automation processes.
  • Academic excellence in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Build & Design: Develop Scytale’s cloud-based platform using cutting-edge technologies such as AWS, microservices, and containerized solutions.
  • Architect Solutions: Participate in architectural decisions, research, and design to deliver scalable and robust software.
  • Full-Stack Development: Implement backend logic, create intuitive frontends, and integrate with third-party APIs.
  • Collaborate: Work closely with product, stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure a seamless, efficient platform.
  • Lead & Mentor: Guide junior developers, promote knowledge sharing, and maintain coding standards.
  • Optimize: Continuously improve the platform’s efficiency, scalability, and maintainability, while staying updated on industry trends.

Benefits

Why Join Scytale?

● Innovative Work: Be part of a cutting-edge product shaping the future of security and compliance, from wherever you work best.

● Real Ownership: Join a fast-moving R&D team where your work has direct impact on the product, architecture, and customer experience.

● Remote-Friendly Collaboration: Work closely with experienced product and engineering teams through clear communication, strong processes, and a culture built on trust.

● Learning & Growth: Grow your career through mentorship, knowledge sharing, courses, and exposure to modern technologies and AI-assisted development practices.

● Independence with Support: Enjoy the autonomy of remote work while staying connected to a collaborative, supportive team that values initiative and accountability.

● Global Impact: Help build a platform used by companies worldwide to simplify and transform cybersecurity compliance.


Ready to innovate and grow with us? Join Scytale and help transform cybersecurity compliance for companies worldwide!
